genxml.title: QLogic ISP12160 dual-channel Ultra2 SCSI host adapter (PCI 1077:1216), the constants the held sources establish
genxml.from: QLogic ISP12160A data sheet (1999); QLogic QLA12160 hardware installation guide (2001); IRIX 6.5 Bedrock-class controller object; IRIX 6.5 Octane SCSI driver object; Linux qla1280, NetBSD isp and OpenBSD qlw drivers (pins in docs/sources/INDEX.md); stock PROM 6.210 SCSI diagnostic
genxml.doc: The two-channel QLogic SCSI host adapter on the Origin 300 IO-8 board and the Origin 350 IO9 board (PCI 1077:1216). Grades say how each item was derived: established means a vendor datasheet, a hardware capture or a driver or firmware statement that names the value directly; inferred means a software expectation, a shipped program that uses the value and does not show the chip's own behaviour, or a reading of a value's meaning from one driver's use of it. No register offsets, reset values or mailbox operand layouts beyond those named here are held for this part, so the register map is not in this unit. The mailbox opcodes are the values the shipped programs send, not measured chip behaviour.

constant.name: BUSES
constant.from: QLogic ISP12160A data sheet (1999), first page: dual-channel Ultra2 SCSI; IRIX 6.5 Octane SCSI driver object sends per-bus commands for a part with more than one bus

constant.name: CONTROLLER_PROGRAM_WORDS
constant.from: IRIX 6.5 Bedrock-class controller object: the separate ISP12160 controller program it carries is 27,706 bytes, and the program's image header word at index 3 is this value

constant.name: DRIVER_SELECTION_TIMEOUT_DEFAULT
constant.from: IRIX 6.5 Octane SCSI driver object: per-bus record defaults for device 0x1216

constant.name: OP_ABORT_DEVICE
constant.from: IRIX 6.5 Bedrock-class controller object, which constructs this request and calls the recovery helper that issues it

constant.name: OP_BUS_RESET
constant.from: IRIX 6.5 Bedrock-class controller object (the request it builds); mailbox placement matches Linux qla1280's bus reset (see the ISP1040 unit's OP_BUS_RESET)

constant.name: OP_DUMP_RAM
constant.from: stock PROM 6.210 SCSI diagnostic, which prepares this opcode against the ISP12160 when it tests DMA

constant.name: OP_LOAD_RAM
constant.from: stock PROM 6.210 SCSI diagnostic, which prepares this opcode against the ISP12160 when it tests DMA

constant.name: OP_SET_SELECTION_TIMEOUT
constant.from: Linux qla1280, NetBSD isp and OpenBSD qlw drivers (none has an ISP12160 branch); IRIX 6.5 Octane SCSI driver object for device 0x1216

constant.name: PCI_BUS_WIDTH_BITS
constant.from: QLogic ISP12160A data sheet (1999), first page: "64-bit bus master"

constant.name: PCI_CLOCK_MHZ
constant.from: QLogic ISP12160A data sheet (1999), first page: "66-MHz, 64-bit PCI host bus interface"
